meta.title: Lakebridge Reconcile: One Engine, Four Report Types

views.label: No reliable primary key?
views.note: row hashes every column with no join key needed -- one of four report types this engine runs.

views.label: Need per-column mismatch detail?
views.note: data joins on key columns and samples the mismatch/missing buckets.

views.label: Just checking the shape?
views.note: schema and aggregate skip row-level comparison entirely.

cards.title: Four checks, one config
items: schema catches a DDL gap the others wouldn't
row hashes every column with no primary key required
data adds join-column comparison and per-column mismatch detail

cards.title: Sampling is built in, not bolted on
items: data and all report types cap mismatch / missing-in-source / missing-in-target rows via sampling_options
aggregate always samples up to 50 rows per bucket regardless of sampling_options
Databricks is a listed source in its own right -- this runs Databricks-to-Databricks, not only legacy-to-Databricks

cards.title: Setup is one command plus a config file
items: databricks labs lakebridge configure-reconcile provisions workspace resources once
one JSON config per source/catalog/report-type, auto-named by convention
the job runs on serverless compute by default -- no cluster to manage
